name: ChiMesh
description: Chicago LoRa Meshtastic mesh — proof-of-mesh build. Three solar-powered RAK4631 nodes in weatherproof IP65 enclosures that prove multi-hop LoRa routing across the city. Includes the build guide, parts catalog, assembly walkthrough, firmware flashing, node provisioning, and a Chicago-specific deployment strategy. ~$192 for the proof batch.

name: Claudia
description: DIY Claude-powered voice assistant on a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W + PiSugar Whisplay HAT. Includes the build guide, parts catalog, automated Pi installer, a Windows console for SSH-based config/logs/updates, configurable wake word (default 'Hey Jarvis'), swappable ASR/TTS/LLM backends, and an FTP deploy for the HTML guide.
